authorization: User expressly requests revising the old human-adjudication rules and minimal manual work after both independent AI reviews.
human_queue_timing: Only after complete validated sealed submissions by both reviewers and automated evidence/schema diagnostics.
human_queue_rule: Only unresolved substantive label disagreements on evaluable questions after documented symmetric material/rule clarification, without showing either reviewer the other answers.
both_uncertain: Retain unresolved source status; do not automatically create a human question or score as correct.
schema_or_field_error: Reject/repair format against the common schema without substituting labels; reviewer must correct semantic interpretation.
material_gap: Return to shared material preparation; send the same corrected evidence and scoped re-review request to both, never ask the human to supply an AI answer.
reported_reference_type: dual-model consensus with human adjudication of residual disagreements; not fully human-validated gold
